title: fix(plugin-audit,service-storage): a delegated caller reads the parent-record gates through the ReadableIds leaf (ADR-0139 D5.1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKoaYYSv3TjMWh4MT5MaF55)_

Fixes #25034

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

ADR-0139 D5.1, as amended by maintainer ruling `6303721609`: the engine composes the `ReadableIds` leaf for a delegated caller from the delegator intersection (ADR-0090 D10, landed in #25009). So a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller is no longer a probe class in the parent-record read gates.

- **`@objectstack/plugin-audit`.** `parent-record-read-gate.ts` drives the activity, ledger and comment-thread gates. `planParentReads` no longer reads the caller: its `context` parameter, `isDelegatedCaller` and the `'delegated-caller'` member of `ParentProbeClass` / `ParentReadPlan` are gone. A delegated caller's read is written the same leaves as any caller's.
- **`@objectstack/service-storage`.** `attachment-access-hooks.ts` gets the same change to the attachment gate: `planAttachmentParentReads(engine, objectAdmission)`, and `WholeReadProbe` is reduced to the two whole-read states.
- **What does not change.** D5.2 (a parent narrowed by an object-scoped read middleware) and D5.3 (a parent bound to another datasource) keep the bounded 2000-row probe. That probe still reads with the caller's full context, delegated envelope included. The two whole-read states (`engine-cannot-classify`, `no-object-admission`) are untouched. ⛔ The gates read no delegation link themselves; the intersection is the engine's and the security service's.
- **No exports change.** None of the changed symbols is exported from either package's index. The module docblocks of `activity-read-visibility.ts`, `audit-log-read-visibility.ts` and `comment-access-hooks.ts` now name two classes.
- **What a caller sees.** Before, a delegated caller past 2000 candidate rows was served a fail-closed truncated list. Now it is served every row its delegator intersection admits, with a true `total`.

## Pins: delegated parity with the probe

**Unit stand-ins.** `comment-thread-leaf.test.ts`, `activity-read-visibility.test.ts` and `attachment-read-leaf.test.ts` pin that a delegated caller is written the same leaves and the same restricted probe as a plain caller. A D5.2 parent is still probed, and its probe read carries `onBehalfOf` and no `__readScope`.

**Real-engine suites.** `parent-record-read-leaf.integration.test.ts` (sys_activity and sys_audit_log), `comment-parent-pair.integration.test.ts` and `attachment-read-leaf.integration.test.ts` give the security stand-in a real delegator intersection: three DOC records are withheld from the delegator. Each suite then pins two things:

1. **Through the leaf.** The delegated read gets leaves for DOC and VAULT, and probe branches for only the GATED (D5.2) and FAR (D5.3) parents. It is served exactly the truth past the 2000-row window (more than 2000 rows), and `count` agrees. The difference from the principal's own read is exactly the rows on the withheld records, so the leaf is the intersection, never the principal's leg alone.
2. **Parity with the probe.** `resolveReadableParentIds` is the probe's own readability function. Asked as the delegated caller over every parent pair at rest (so no window cuts it), it admits exactly the set the leaf serves.

## Ablation (services lane)

Each new pin was run against the behavior it forbids, then restored.

- **The old routing restored.** `parent-record-read-gate.ts` and `attachment-access-hooks.ts` were checked out from `e58bd0e3`, which brings back `isDelegatedCaller` → `'delegated-caller'`. **All 10 new pins went red:**
  - plugin-audit 7/96 failed: both unit pins in `activity-read-visibility.test.ts` (`expected [ null ] to deeply equal [ 'crm_case', 'crm_deal', null ]`), the `comment-thread-leaf.test.ts` pin (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'crm_case', 'crm_deal' ]`), and 2 + 2 integration pins. The leaf-set assertions failed with `expected [] to deeply equal ArrayContaining ["e5_doc", "e5_vault"]`. The parity pins failed on the truncated window: 1764 or 1771 rows served against 2299 admitted.
  - service-storage 3/31 failed: the unit pin (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'att_case', 'att_secret' ]`), and the leaf and parity pins, 1758 rows served against 2299.
- **The leaf composed for the principal alone.** In the built engine, `ObjectQL#readableIdsScopeOf` was handed `{ ...chain.context, onBehalfOf: undefined }`. **All 6 intersection and parity pins went red.** The withheld rows leaked: 2302 against 2299 for activity and attachments, and 2303 against 2299 for comments, since four comments sit on the withheld threads.
- Both ablations were restored, from `HEAD` and from a byte copy of the engine's `dist`. The full suites are green afterwards.

## Checklist

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json` is a `domain:devx` path, declared in the claim. In `attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls`, at revision 7, `knownGaps[2]`, `acceptance[3]`, `automated.ref` and `source` named a delegated caller among D5's three classes. They now name the two remaining classes, and earlier history entries are unchanged. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
